decisions: Build the 'Enterprise Autonomous Action Engine' positioned as a 'smart senior co-worker' capable of multi-day task execution.
Launch V1 exclusively as a tightly constrained vertical wedge (Finance or Legal) rather than a generalized horizontal platform.
Move the enterprise monetization model to outcome-based or value-based pricing mapped to the economic value of the labor being augmented or replaced.
Halt V1 development of generalized horizontal agent frameworks to avoid catastrophic brand risk from early hallucination loops.
Decline near-term integration into native consumer ambient hardware (AR/VR).
Build a persistent memory scaffolding layer to snapshot, serialize, and safely park agent state during asynchronous execution.
Deploy strict compute circuit-breakers at the infrastructure level to forcibly terminate runaway inference loops.
Initiate immediate renegotiation of cloud vendor contracts to secure massive, bulk preemptible compute explicitly dedicated to asynchronous agent background tasks.
Implement intentional UX loading states during session handoffs to set realistic latency expectations.

disagreements.resolution: Resolved to 'Launch V1 exclusively as a tightly constrained vertical wedge (Finance or Legal)'

disagreements.topic: consumer AR/wearables vs Enterprise Autonomous Action Engine
disagreements.resolution: Product_Designer explicitly dropped their initial push for AR/VR spatial computing to back the enterprise agent consensus.
Resolved by mandating 'hard-coded operational guardrails' and 'compute circuit-breakers' built into the V1 Enterprise UI to control runaway compute.

pushed_for: horizontally scalable platform for fully autonomous, multi-step agents
hard 'circuit breakers' at the infrastructure layer
constrained vertical wedge to mitigate chain-of-thought drift
pushed_back_on: zero chain-of-thought drift for an unconstrained, multi-day horizontal agent
bespoke hardware supply chains or disjointed model architectures
unbounded background execution without predefined financial guardrails

pushed_for: high-value vertical first—like healthcare or finance
value-based pricing (charging for labor replaced or workflows completed)
vertical wedge in Finance or Legal

alternatives_considered: continuous, ambient AI agent natively integrated with spatial computing or wearables
